summary: Tauri launcher with corrected startup progress.
body:
Nitrogen Squared 0.2.1

A smoother home for your next run.

The Tk canvas interface has been replaced with a Tauri launcher adapted from Dittobyte/Recompia. Responsive layouts, Inter typography, Lucide controls and shared background task state make navigation consistent. The project now uses GPL-3.0-or-later; credits and full notices are included.

The launcher now has N2O-inspired tunnel artwork, the original N² logo, a persistent sidebar, release notes and organised settings. Setup progress stays visible while you browse.

Display & audio
Choose window mode, HUD scale, scene resolution and master volume before launch. These are the same preferences used by the in-game Video and Audio menus.

Your controls & files
Find the keyboard controls, custom binding files, saves and asset folders in Settings. Existing saves and custom input profiles are preserved.

Verified 0.2.0 changes, included here
The launcher tracks compiled-game inputs separately from its version. Launcher-only updates reuse a compatible game build; runtime changes require preparation. The first upgrade from 0.1.x prepares once.

0.2.0 was verified but was not released separately.

Startup progress fix
Play now shows disc verification and enters Running only after the runtime confirms its process. Startup output is unbuffered, worker stdin is separate from the launcher protocol, and rapid status changes stay visible. Compatible compiled games remain reusable. The Linux CI audio-startup check now uses observed progress with a bounded deadline.
